thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — service: heartbeat-checker-prod | symptom: missing-heartbeat (threshold 30s) | severity: low

pagerduty: Alert triggered: INC12345 — unacknowledged

Samir: acked — taking it. I’m on the metrics side.

Maya: pinged infra to see if there was a deploy or network churn in the region. Not seeing any deploys in last 10m.

Samir: looking at exporter logs — prometheus node-exporter on svc-heartbeat-1 has a handful of socket timeout errors around now. running: `kubectl logs svc-heartbeat-1 -c exporter --since=2m`

ops-bot: healthcheck summary: svc-heartbeat pods: 3/3 ready, one pod restarted 3m ago (OOMKilled) — reason: transient memory bump on sidecar.

Samir: interesting. exporter had a GC pause + sidecar restart. metrics ingestion gap ~12s — heartbeat missing window matched that.

Maya: any customer-facing impact? request volumes normal on frontends. No errors in gateway logs.

Samir: quick grep on prod logs shows heartbeat probe resume at +14s after the restart. Sequence: sidecar restart -> metrics gap -> PD alert. Looks self-healing.

Lia: thanks. can we silence flapping for this class of short gaps? PD gets noisy.

Samir: proposing: change alert threshold from 30s -> 60s for the ephemeral heartbeat metric, and add a 30s dedup window for missing-heartbeat alerts. Also add a suppression rule for restarts on that daemonset.

Maya: +1 to threshold change if we confirm it's safe. any chance this masks real issues?

Samir: low risk — this heartbeat is a soft indicator; we still have request-level SLO alerts and consumer error logs. I'll open a quick PR for alert config and add a note to runbook.

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by Samir

ops-bot: PagerDuty: auto-resolve triggered — alert cleared (missing-heartbeat resolved)

Samir: marking root cause: transient exporter/sidecar restart causing brief metrics gap. Action items: 1) PR to increase missing-heartbeat threshold to 60s (Samir) 2) add dedup/suppression rule for known restart windows (Maya) 3) add note to oncall runbook about interpreting short gaps (Lia).

Lia: please tag the PR with `oncall-alert-tuning` and ping me for a quick review. If this happens again and we see request errors, escalate immediately.

Maya: filing the issue in infra board now, assigning ops for sidecar memory check.

Samir: thanks — closing the thread. no customer impact observed. :white_check_mark:

Lia: :thumbsup: good triage.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 resolved by system (auto-resolve)

ops-bot: Note appended to INC12345: "Transient exporter/sidecar restart caused metric gap ~12s; adjusted alerting planned to reduce noise. No customer impact."

Samir: follow-up: PR link https://redwood.internal/alerts/PR/4829 — feel free to comment.

Maya: ack, will track.

Lia: leaving a short postmortem entry in incidents doc later today.
